hero.subtitle: I am a Full-Stack Developer passionate about building robust, scalable platforms and leveraging AI workflows to ship high-quality products faster.

bullets: Architected and deployed scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, strictly adhering to SOLID principles and MVC architecture.
Led critical backend migrations, successfully transitioning Node.js/Express infrastructure from Render to Supabase Edge Functions for significantly improved latency and scalability.
Leveraged Google AI Studio and Gemini models to accelerate development, generating complex database schemas and optimizing application logic.
Applied structural design patterns (Repository and Strategy) to develop localized calculation engines and interactive educational platforms.
Delivered high-end architectural visualizations and 3D modeling for major international projects, including contributions to the Dubai Expo 2020.
Utilized professional-grade software such as 3DS Max, and AutoCAD to create highly realistic product renderings and spatial designs.
Bridged the gap between deep spatial intuition and technical execution, laying the groundwork for developing AI-driven spatial design platforms.

projects.title: HDE - Construction Estimator
projects.description: A comprehensive SaaS platform tailored for the Indian market, providing highly accurate material and labor cost estimations. Built a logic-heavy estimation engine based on real-time data.
projects.impact: Evolved from its original prototype by rigorously optimizing SPA routing, managing strict version control to maintain a highly reliable core architecture, and implementing a Role-Based Access Control system.

projects.title: AI Home Decorator
projects.description: An end-to-end spatial design mobile application allowing users to visualize interior transformations in real-time. Engineered prompts and API pipelines to handle complex image-to-image AI transformations.
projects.impact: Managed the entire product lifecycle—from development to Google Play Store deployment, managing international payment gateways, and executing digital advertising campaigns.

projects.title: Wall Paint AI
projects.description: An AI-driven tool focused on real-time color visualization for architectural surfaces, utilizing a deep background in professional 3D visualization.
projects.impact: Achieved highly realistic color blending on irregular surfaces by combining advanced CSS masking techniques with AI-driven edge detection.
